summary: Two climbers (man and woman, mid-20s) stuck on the Rupert route, Red Garden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park after their rappel rope jammed during descent; called dispatch ~10:55 p.m.; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group located them and assisted them back to the trailhead — cold and tired but uninjured after a ~4-hour operation
location: Red Garden Wall, Rupert route, Eldorado Canyon State Park
